name: Malaysia
overview: In the late 90s, Malaysia promoted itself as “Truly Asia” on our TV screens. Three decades later, we can vouch for that ad campaign. As a Muslim-majority nation with significant Chinese and Indian diasporas, Malaysia can unabashedly claim to represent the best of the continent.

seo.title: Malaysia travel guide | Pareto Travel
seo.description: Malaysia calls itself “Truly Asia”, which sounds like a slogan invented in a tourism-board conference room until you actually walk around Kuala Lumpur.
